quarantine.quarantine_posture: A quarantined item is moved to a governed holding disposition retaining its identity, provenance, and history for authoritative resolution; a dead-letter disposition applies only after a transport accepted an event and a downstream consumer failed it.
quarantine.reconciliation_dependency: A quarantined item is resolved only through reconciliation against the House governed state; it never silently expires.
quarantine.compensation_limitation: Correction uses forward compensation; it cannot un-commit a governed fact, delete an audit event, or fabricate an outcome.
